integrity: The universal statement is proved symbolically. The embedded finite verifier is a supplementary stress test over 7656 parameter pairs; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the Datta--Upadhyay family \(T_{n,1,k}\); it is not a classification of all torus triangulations.
An unindexed older lattice-coordinate source could contain an equivalent arithmetic criterion under different notation.
title: An exact flag criterion for the cyclic weakly regular torus family
